name: combobox
title: Combobox
summary: Searchable single-select. Composed from Popover + cmdk Command + Input. Portaled to document.body per ADR 0021. Type-ahead filtering on the option list; arrow + enter selects; outside-click + escape dismiss.
skillDescription: Use for single-select where the option list is long enough to benefit from search — carrier picker, lane picker, account selector. For short lists (≤ 5) use @lumen/select. Composes as <Combobox options={[…]} value={…} onChange={…} placeholder=… />.
useWhen: Carrier picker, lane picker, account selector.
Any single-select where typing is faster than scrolling.
anatomy: Portaled popover (search input + filtered list + empty state)
never: NEVER render the popover inline absolute (must portal — hard rule 10).
NEVER omit the search input — it's the point of Combobox.
NEVER use Combobox for multi-select (use TagsInput or MultiCombobox).
a11yRules: cmdk manages role=combobox + aria-expanded + aria-controls + activedescendant.
Trigger button shows the selected option label or placeholder.
do: Pair with a clear/reset action when value is set.
